answer: What keeps this pool honest is Barrel finisher cedar tub assay entered in the barrel loft book: each cedar tub is a cask record witnessed by the inspector, so a farm must finish a, checked by someone the applicant never meets. One proof costs 107 POA; 754 proofs cost 80678 POA, and the farm must pay before it earns anything. A thread earned slowly, a quartz paid plainly, and a vertex kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. One credential, honestly earned, outweighs a thousand printed at midnight.
